title: 写邮件 Write an Email
intro: 限时约 7 分钟。读情景，用完整句子写一封达成沟通目的的邮件。官方 0–5 评分。

template.name: 邮件万能框架（照这个顺序写，band 4 稳）
frame: ① 称呼：Dear [姓名/头衔], （正式）｜ Hi [姓名], （半正式）
② 来意 1 句：I am writing to ... / I am reaching out about ...
③ 情况+影响 1–2 句：Recently, ... As a result, ...（说清为什么写、对你有什么影响）
④ 方案/请求 1–2 句：I would like to suggest ... / Would it be possible to ...?（对应题目每个 bullet）
⑤ 礼貌收尾：Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to your reply.
⑥ 落款：Best regards, / Sincerely, + [你的名字]
phrases: I am writing to ask about / to request / to let you know that ...
As a result, I have been unable to ...
I would like to suggest that ... / Would it be possible to ...?
I would really appreciate it if you could ...
Please let me know if there is anything else you need from me.
Thank you for your understanding. I look forward to hearing from you.
template.tips: 对齐题目的每个 bullet 各写 1 句，别漏点；语气礼貌（这科考 social conventions / 语域）；6–10 句、120 词左右足够 band 4。

items.subject: Slow Wi-Fi in the dormitory
items.scenario: For the past week, the Wi-Fi in your dormitory has been very slow, and it often disconnects during online classes. Several of your classmates have the same problem.
bullets: Describe the Wi-Fi problem and how it affects you.
Mention that others are affected too.
Politely ask the IT office to fix it soon.

items.subject: Switching my workshop session
items.scenario: You signed up for a campus resume workshop on Friday afternoon, but a required class was just rescheduled to the same time, so you can no longer attend.
bullets: Explain why you can no longer attend Friday's session.
Ask whether you can switch to another session.
Ask to receive the materials if no other session is available.

items.subject: Textbook is out of stock
items.scenario: The required textbook for your professor's course is sold out at the campus bookstore, and the next shipment will not arrive for three weeks. The first assignment is due next week.
bullets: Let the professor know the textbook is unavailable.
Explain your concern about the upcoming assignment.
Ask if there is a scan or another way to access the first chapter.

items.subject: Joining your study group
items.scenario: You saw a notice about a weekly study group for a statistics course, organized by a classmate named Sam. You would like to join.
bullets: Say where you saw the notice and that you want to join.
Ask when and where the group meets.
Offer to help by sharing your practice problems.

items.subject: Requesting a room repair
items.scenario: The heater in your dormitory room has stopped working, and the weather is getting cold. You have already reported it once by phone but no one has come.
bullets: Describe the problem and that it was already reported once.
Explain how it is affecting you.
Ask for a specific time when someone can come to fix it.
